en.apiKeyHint: Leave blank to read the provider env var; local Ollama needs none.
en.autoOllamaHint: Probe local Ollama at http://localhost:11434 at startup and use it as a fallback — images never leave your machine and no key is needed.
en.baseUrlHint: OpenAI-compatible endpoint (…/chat/completions is appended). Leave blank for the provider default.
en.baseUrlPlaceholder: Leave blank for the provider default
en.intro: Native multimodal conversation models receive images directly; otherwise the vision model below transcribes them to text.
en.markerHint: Used only for text-only fallback: prefix prepended to each transcription. Default [图片转译].
en.maxTokensHint: Output token cap for the vision model; larger is more thorough but costs more.
en.modelHint: Vision model id. Leave blank for the provider default.
en.modelPlaceholder: Leave blank for the provider default
en.providerHint: Vision provider used to transcribe attached images. Model and endpoint can be overridden below.
en.requiredHint: A custom provider needs an endpoint and a model
en.timeoutHint: Request timeout. Local/anonymous endpoints are hard-capped at 20s.
en.title: Vision API configuration
